title: The lane brief carries the repository's precedent for the modules it names
body:
Why: D23 diagnosis (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/results-iface2, regrade-iface2) shows 17/20 hidden-test failures in both arms are right module, wrong behavior: exact messages, exit codes, output shapes that the repository's history already fixes as conventions. Plain harnesses never mine that history; KRN's worker brief can.
Outcome: `krn lane brief` appends a Precedent section for the modules the brief names (Scope paths and interface module paths): the 3 most recent commits reachable from HEAD touching each module with their test-file diff hunks, and the existing test files importing the module, within a fixed token budget; nothing from commits not reachable from HEAD.
Proof: a test on a fixture repository asserts the section lists the right commits and test hunks, respects the budget, and ignores a commit on an unmerged branch.
Scope: src/brain/, src/cli/lane.ts, test/brain/, test/cli/.
